author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: See every plan a repository holds
purpose: Lets the operator see every plan in a repository, including draft and proposed plans that were otherwise hard to find. Plans that are not yet governed show their stated trigger, or say plainly that they have none.
serves: Serves the milestone of full visibility into a repository's plans, which supports the Project outcome of not needing to hold the whole portfolio in one's head.
done_when: The plans command lists every plan in a repository with its status, and the Project page shows its active plan and links to the full list.

actions.title: Add a read-only command that lists a repository's plans
actions.why: Draft and proposed plans were hidden unless someone opened the plan folder by hand.
actions.done_when: Running the command lists every plan with its status and, for governed plans, its Action counts; ungoverned plans are labelled, and their trigger is quoted or its absence is stated.

actions.title: Show a Project's plans on its detail page
actions.why: Lets the operator reach the full plan list from the Project page, not only from the command line.
actions.done_when: The Project page shows its active plan and up to three others, with a link to the full list that matches the command's fields, and a Project with no repository path says so.
